info.title: AcoCam Trading Inc. API
info.description:
Complete API for the AcoCam Trading Inc. logistics platform.

## Authentication
All protected endpoints require a **JWT Bearer token** in the `Authorization` header.

Obtain tokens via the `/api/auth/login` (user) or `/api/auth/admin/login` (admin) endpoints.

## Real-time Events (Socket.io)
Connect to the server via Socket.io with `auth: { token }`.

### Client Events
| Event | Room | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `join:user` | `user:{userId}` | Join personal user room |
| `join:admin` | `admins` | Join admin broadcast room |

### Server Events
| Event | Description |
|---|---|
| `quotation:created` | New quotation submitted |
| `quotation:updated` | Quotation status changed |
| `shipment:created` | New shipment created |
| `shipment:updated` | Shipment status/location updated |
| `payment:updated` | Payment verified/rejected |
| `notification:new` | New notification for user |
